summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.85. Privileged lab-admin account (s.demir@aegean.edu) successfully authenticated eight times in ~30 minutes from a single cloud VPS (45.142.10.9, Cloudvault, Frankfurt, DE) via the flagged vulnerable VPN appliance vpn-edge-01, alternating portal/LMS with no device_id recorded. MFA was approved once (21:31, count=1) and every subsequent success had mfa_prompt_count=0, indicating session/MFA bypass or credential reuse rather than normal per-login MFA. No mail events provide a benign explanation, and a VPS IP in a foreign country is unexplained for a university lab admin. This is strong evidence of account takeover via the vulnerable appliance, warranting immediate containment (disable account, revoke sessions/tokens, investigate vpn-edge-01).
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
